_about: T-069 M3 exit: the PLAN.md §1 M3 exit scenarios, the Done-when CLIN ids and the stock fixture mapped to the exact test cases that prove each (JUnit classname = file, name = 'describe > test'). Checked by check-scenarios.py against a JUnit report of `pnpm test -- m3`: required scenario titles and CLIN ids present; every title a PRD §8 scenario and every CLIN id a PRD CLIN row; every mapped name in its file; every mapped case present once and passed; no failure anywhere. 'proves' states what the cases assert; 'open' what M3 does not prove and the task that completes it.

tests: scenario PR-14: four outcomes > patient-chosen stop: counted; the performer and the actual materials are recorded
scenario PR-14: four outcomes > completed: counted; the actual materials are consumed once; the visit's treatment step is done
scenario PR-14: four outcomes > medical stop: not counted; a reason is required; no front-office blocker
scenario PR-14: four outcomes > clinic stop: not counted; the front office gets the blocker
scenarios.proves: the four outcomes: a patient-chosen stop counts as used and records the performer and the actual materials; completed counts and consumes once; medical and clinic stops do not count (T-064)
scenarios.open: the session use and the performer's commission (PLAN M3: 'session and commission effects in M4/M5'): package sessions T-076 (M4), commission T-087 (M5)

tests: scenario PR-16: no double deduction > a pack of cotton issued to a room; a treatment using the standard per-treatment model completes → stock is not deducted a second time
scenario PR-16: no double deduction > a second treatment from the same room pack is not deducted either; return and waste of a consumed bulk line are refused
scenarios.proves: a bulk pack issued to a room is not deducted again when treatments using it complete; a consumed bulk line cannot be returned or wasted (T-062)

tests: scenario PR-17 transfer (the transfer half) > 10 at branch A, 0 at B; 4 sent and received → A 6, B 4 with the same batch number and expiry
scenario PR-17 transfer (the transfer half) > cancel while sent returns the stock to the source depot; conservation per finished transfer
scenarios.proves: an inter-branch transfer of 4 of 10 leaves A 6 and B 4 with the same batch number and expiry; a cancelled transfer returns the stock (T-061)
scenarios.open: PR-17's purchasing half (PO, receipt) is PR-90 below (T-067)

tests: scenario PR-18: automatic list > two treatments and one product confirmed → the list shows both formulas' materials and the product, no manual entry
scenario PR-18: automatic list > an unmapped recipe row, a missing room depot and a treatment without recipe are shown, never dropped; Siapkan refuses them
scenarios.proves: a confirmed selection of two treatments and one product puts both formulas' materials and the product on the pharmacy list without manual entry; gaps are shown, never dropped (T-065)
scenarios.open: UX-7 Diskusi Pilihan panel and UX-8 Resep panel wiring (later UI tasks); the payment rule for dispensing (T-072)

tests: scenario PR-75: supplier return > a batch received from a supplier; 5 units returned with a reason → stock −5 at the moving average; a credit note is expected
scenarios.proves: a return of 5 units with a reason lowers stock by 5 at the moving average and opens one credit expectation (T-066)
scenarios.open: posting the return (BILL-34 journal) in M8

tests: invoices, payments, credit notes, reversals (open points 3–7; r1 P2-4, P2-5, P2-7, P3-8) > credit notes: from a return (closes T-066's expectation) or an invoice; applied atomically; write-off; reversal
scenarios.proves: the expected credit is closed by the supplier's credit note and applied to an invoice (T-067)

tests: scenario PR-82: a device past its calibration due date > the due date passes without an entry: the branch manager sees it in Perlu Ditangani, once; an entry moves the due date
scenarios.proves: a device past its calibration due date without an entry raises one alert for the branch manager (the Perlu Ditangani data: the manager's notification and the overdue device first in the logbook) (T-068)
scenarios.open: the Ringkasan pages that render Perlu Ditangani and the daily scheduler that calls logbook_due_scan (later tasks, as PR-73 / T-050)

tests: scenario PR-89: depot transfer > 10 vials in the gudang; 4 to Ruang Tindakan 1 → gudang 6, room 4, one transfer record and two linked movements
scenarios.proves: a transfer of 4 of 10 vials from the gudang to a room depot leaves 6 and 4 with one transfer record and two linked movements (T-061)

tests: scenario PR-89: concurrent depot transfers > 5 in the gudang; two transfers of 4 at the same time → one succeeds, one is refused for insufficient stock; replaying the successful key changes nothing
scenarios.proves: of two concurrent transfers of 4 from 5, one succeeds and one is refused for insufficient stock; replaying the successful key changes nothing (T-061)

tests: scenario PR-90: supplier payable > a goods receipt of Rp5,000,000 with an invoice due in 30 days; finance pays Rp2,000,000 → Rp3,000,000 outstanding
scenarios.proves: an invoice of a Rp5,000,000 receipt due in 30 days, paid Rp2,000,000, shows Rp3,000,000 outstanding (T-067)
scenarios.open: posting (BILL-34) and the monthly roll-forward in M8

tests: scenario PR-90: supplier payable > no double allocation: two payments of Rp2,000,000 allocated concurrently to Rp3,000,000 outstanding → 2,000,000 + 1,000,000, never over-paid
scenario PR-90: supplier payable > payment and credit application at once never over-settle an invoice
scenarios.proves: two concurrent payments of Rp2,000,000 on Rp3,000,000 outstanding allocate 2,000,000 and 1,000,000; a payment and a credit application at once never over-settle (T-067)

items.item: CLIN-008 retried completion: one transition, one deduction
tests: CLIN-008: retried completion — one transition, one deduction > a standard item: replay returns the same consumption; two concurrent completions: one wins; one consume movement
items.proves: a replayed or concurrent completion makes one transition and one consume movement (T-062)

items.item: CLIN-008 retried completion: one transition, one deduction
tests: materials at the finish (P1-1) > Bahan Tambahan is a second request of the item, consumed at the finish too; an open request blocks the finish; replay consumes nothing more
items.proves: a replayed treatment finish consumes nothing more (T-064)

items.item: CLIN-017 signed Rx not handed over: no stock or quota change
tests: dispensing (CLIN-017, CLIN-018, CD-19) > CLIN-017: a signed prescription prepared but not handed over changes no stock and no movement
items.proves: a signed prescription prepared but not handed over changes no stock and writes no movement (T-065)

tests: dispensing (CLIN-017, CLIN-018, CD-19) > CLIN-018: a handover retried (same key, new key, concurrently) is one dispensing and one movement per batch
items.proves: a handover retried with the same key, a new key or concurrently is one dispensing and one movement per batch (T-065)

tests: CLIN-019 fitness and FEFO (open point 5) > FEFO takes the fit open vial first, then sealed stock by expiry; never an expired, recalled, quarantined batch or a lapsed vial
CLIN-019 fitness and FEFO (open point 5) > the expiry day is judged in the branch's time zone: 16:30 UTC is the next day in WITA but not in WIB
items.proves: FEFO never offers an expired, recalled or quarantined batch or a lapsed vial; the expiry day is judged in the branch's time zone (T-060)

tests: dispensing (CLIN-017, CLIN-018, CD-19) > quarantine, temperature excursion and recall block preparation and handover; release needs a reason; the history keeps every reason
items.proves: quarantined, temperature-excursion and recalled stock blocks preparation and handover (T-065)

tests: requests and issue (open points 2, 3; P1-1, P1-2) > unfit stock is not issued; insufficient stock refuses the whole issue and keeps nothing
items.proves: unfit stock is never issued to a room (T-062)

items.item: CLIN-024 pharmacist adverse-effect flag escalates clinically
tests: CLIN-024 and CLIN-025 > CLIN-024: the pharmacist's adverse-effect flag from the handover becomes a clinical task for the branch's clinician
items.proves: the pharmacist's adverse-effect flag at handover becomes a clinical task for the branch's clinicians (T-065 with T-057)

items.item: CLIN-024 pharmacist adverse-effect flag escalates clinically
tests: CLIN-016 and CLIN-024: worse symptoms; a pharmacist's adverse-effect flag > worse symptoms → a clinical task due by SET-31 (kuning by default); the pharmacist source is the pharmacist's
items.proves: the pharmacist source is the pharmacist's own and becomes a clinical task with its due time (T-057)

tests: CLIN-024 and CLIN-025 > CLIN-025: a queued or prepared dispensing blocks closing the visit; after handover or cancellation it closes
items.proves: a queued or prepared dispensing blocks closing the visit; after handover or cancellation it closes (T-065)

items.item: stock fixture: no double deduction, depot balances never negative
tests: M3 stock fixture > one stock item through every M3 writer: no double deduction, every depot balance never negative, conservation per batch
items.proves: one item received, transferred between depots and branches, issued, consumed (with retries), returned, wasted, dispensed and returned to the supplier: each movement once, every holding ≥ 0 after every step, and the batch total equals receipts minus outflows

items.item: stock fixture: no double deduction, depot balances never negative
tests: the batch ↔ movement invariant and the guards (plan P1-2) > a quantity changes only by a movement; a movement continues the balance; movements are never changed or deleted; nothing goes negative
items.proves: a batch quantity changes only by a movement and never goes negative (guards on the owner connection, T-060)

items.item: stock fixture: no double deduction, depot balances never negative
tests: guards (plan P1-2, P2-2) > a holding changes only by its movement; movements name a depot of their batch's branch; nothing is deleted; legs tie to kinds
items.proves: a depot holding changes only by its movement (T-061)

deferred.part: session counts as used; the performer earns commission
